name: American Society of Neurorehabilitation Annual Meeting 2027 (ASNR2027)
description: The American Society of Neurorehabilitation Annual Meeting brings together clinicians and researchers working on recovery of function after neurological injury, with a focus areas including stroke motor recovery and neuromodulation. The 2027 meeting is currently announced only as a save the date.

prior_edition.city: Long Beach, CA, USA (Hyatt Regency Long Beach)

sources.note: Official ASNR account announcing March 16-18, 2027 dates and Durham Convention Center venue
Official site homepage banner filename 'ASNR2027_save_the_date.png' corroborates a save the date exists, though the page text itself did not render the details

notes: Only a save-the-date has been announced, via ASNR's own official X/Twitter and Facebook accounts; the main asnr.com site does not yet have a full ASNR2027 program page with abstract or registration deadlines. This is the American Society of Neurorehabilitation, distinct from the similarly-abbreviated American Society of Neuroradiology (also ASNR), which was excluded.
